PLAN: Complete the validated ethane-stripper optimization with the final solve. Reflux increases from 4.0 to 4.5, 5.0, and 5.5 each produced a small net gain at boil-up 0.5. Test 6.0 while holding the proven R899 core fixed, then stop and retain the best valid design.
LEARNED: Boil-up 0.5 is near optimum; 0.1 collapses C3 sales. Higher reflux recovered additional C3 bottoms with slightly greater revenue than cost. All upstream cuts remain fixed because earlier changes damaged much more valuable C4/C5 sales. At reflux 5.5 reward is 0.542, revenue $803.3M/yr, cost $565.7M/yr, C3 bottoms 281 mol/s.
